fields.t: second since the run started; the bucket covers [t, t+1)
fields.dependencyRequests: requests received by the dependency in this second (measured at the dependency, admitted + rejected + refused)
fields.succeeded: logical operations that completed successfully in this second (client side)
fields.failed: logical operations that completed with a failure in this second (client side)
fields.inFlight: peak number of requests inside the dependency (in service + queued + held by the freeze) in this second
fields.started: logical operations that started in this second (closed loop: depends on the strategy)
fields.attemptsSent: attempts the client sent in this second (cross-check for dependencyRequests)
fields.retriesSent: attempts number 2 to 4 sent in this second
fields.retriesDenied: strategy D: retries the budget refused in this second
fields.rejected503: requests the dependency rejected at once because workers and queue were full
fields.restart503: requests failed by the restart (all in the restart's second)
fields.refused503: requests refused during the outage after the restart (0 when the outage is 0 ms)
fields.queued: peak number of requests waiting in the dependency's queue in this second (held requests count during the freeze)

fineFields.fromMs: start of the first bucket; element i of every array covers [fromMs + i*100, fromMs + (i+1)*100) ms
fineFields.dependencyRequests: requests received by the dependency (admitted + rejected + refused)
fineFields.active: peak number of requests inside the dependency (in service + queued + held)
fineFields.queued: peak number of requests waiting for a worker
fineFields.rejected503: rejected at once: workers and queue full
fineFields.attempt1: first attempts sent by the client (new logical operations)
fineFields.retriesDenied: strategy D: retries refused by the budget
fineFields.failed: logical operations completed with a failure
